title: Choose CORELINE's visual world
question: Keep the assigned Athlete Field Kit, take one alternate, choose the familiar category standard, or re-roll with an optional steer.

options.label: Athlete Field Kit
options.lineage: training-camp credentials, coach packets, and track-lane markings
options.thesis: Your real life becomes a deployable daily performance brief.
options.viewport: A portrait athlete dossier anchors the top while today's train, fuel, and recover route locks below it.
options.risk: Can feel militarized if human imagery and recovery language lose warmth.

options.label: Graphite Control Deck
options.lineage: dark-first developer consoles and instrument panels
options.thesis: Every health signal occupies one persistent, precise control panel.
options.case: Product clarity is excellent, but audience identification is weaker and the human routine risks feeling like software administration.
options.viewport: A dense but ordered Today panel holds readiness, workout, fuel, and supplement state without changing frames.
options.risk: Technical density can become cold and visually predictable.

options.label: Deployable Plan Sheet
options.lineage: Miura-fold aerospace sheets and linked crease diagrams
options.thesis: One pull turns a compact profile into a linked training, food, and recovery plan.
options.case: The personalized-plan mechanism fuses beautifully, but folded geometry makes repeated daily actions less immediately familiar.
options.viewport: A compact profile packet opens diagonally into today's connected workout, nutrition, recovery, and supplement cells.
options.risk: The geometry can compete with labels and small-screen scanning.

options.label: Crew Readiness Terminal
options.lineage: used-future starship terminals and equipment paperwork
options.thesis: The day reads like a crew readiness check before a demanding mission.
options.case: Identity is strong for game-literate users, but command grammar lowers accessibility and weakens food and profile clarity.
options.viewport: A phosphor readiness readout types today's workout, meals, recovery, and supplement checks beneath a crew badge.
options.risk: The theatrical terminal can overpower everyday utility.

canonCard.label: Premium Fitness Dashboard
canonCard.thesis: A polished mobile fitness dashboard with familiar cards, rings, imagery, and bottom navigation.
canonCard.viewport: A hero progress card sits above modular workout, nutrition, and supplement sections.
canonCard.risk: Immediately usable, but it looks like the category and makes CORELINE harder to remember.
